## Status

GREEN, review ready at `220b51f2` (round 3); `775-offformat-seq-advance` -> `dev` (based on dev `a032c6d6`, still the dev tip).

Round 3 (`220b51f2`): full sweep as four shards: 64/64 suites, 2,189,668 checks, 0 failures. avtp_rxmon: NX 218/0, `format_mutants.py` 13/13, `lockstep_mutants.py` 14/14, lockstep N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0. `behave` 406 scenarios, 0 failed. 30 static gates rc 0, lint 89 <= 89. The docs workflow's gates under GNU Make 4.3: 42 run, all rc 0. The RTL changes only in comments (identical after comment stripping), so no route was run.

Round 2 (`c2a080ae`): full sweep as four shards: 64/64 suites, 2,189,642 checks, 0 failures. avtp_rxmon: NX 194/0, `format_mutants.py` 11/11, `lockstep_mutants.py` 14/14, lockstep N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0. 30 static gates rc 0, lint 89 <= 89. The docs workflow's gates under GNU Make 4.3: 42 run, all rc 0. The RTL changes only in comments (identical after comment stripping), so route-1x1 was not rerun.

Round 1 (`c7e87c8c`): full sweep as four shards: 64/64 suites, 2,189,615 checks, 0 failures. avtp_rxmon: NX 169/0, `format_mutants.py` 9/9, `lockstep_mutants.py` 14/14. crf_rx: unit 15,714/0, `mutants.py` 23/23. Yosys 60/60 tops. Lint at its ratchet. 30 static gates rc 0. The docs workflow's gates under GNU Make 4.3: 42 run, all rc 0. route-1x1 is fully routed, with WNS +0.141 ns and WHS +0.019 ns. The resource gate passes against the 2026-10-23 record: SLICE 15,833 (-2), LUT +54, FF +10, RAMB/DSP unchanged.

## Linked Issue / roles

Closes #775
Relates to #765

Executor: `[A666]`
Internal cleared-context reviewer: `[R<n>]`
External reviewer: `[R<n>]`

## Description

On the bench, one PDU of an in-order stream replaced by a PDU of another format (another channel count on an AAF input, or an AAF PDU on the CRF input) counted UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT +1, which is #765's fix, and SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH +1 on both inputs. The discarded PDU did not advance the input's sequence state, so the next in-order PDU looked non-sequential.

The ruling on #775 (Milan v1.2 Table 5.6): an off-format Stream Data AVTPDU is a received PDU. Its sequence_num advances the input's sequence state, while it counts only UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT and presents nothing.

| Commit | File:line at `c7e87c8c` (round 1) | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `0ee987f4` | `hdl/ieee1722/avtp/KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv:1009-1020` | AAF input. In M_PDEC_S's `!fmt_ok_w` branch the walker keeps MON_STATE and replaces only prev_seq (`[7:0]`) with the PDU's sequence_num, which is what an accepted PDU writes there. Then it moves to the new state `M_PSEQ_S` (`:292`, write `:638-642`, exit `:1061`), which writes that one word and returns to idle. Lock, settle, wire_chans and the mr reference keep their values. No accept verdict is given, no timestamp word is written and no counter walks. Only the UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT flag is raised, as before |
| `0ee987f4` | `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/reference/KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx_ref.sv:15-16,292,619-623,990-993,1045` | the lockstep reference takes the same edit in the same lines (the #762 and #765 precedent). Its soak sends off-format PDUs, so the cycle-exact `[LS]`/`[GC]` compare stays exact. #775 is graded by `[SQ]` by count, never against this copy |
| `6ff2880a` | `hdl/ieee1722/crf/KL_crf_rx.sv:603-607` | CRF input. The rejected branch sets `exp_seq_r <= seq_i + 1`. `have_seq_r` is unchanged, so only an accepted PDU seeds the cursor (the first-PDU behaviour is kept) |
| `c7e87c8c` | `docs/reference/FR_NFR.md` FR-STR-03, `docs/reference/MILAN_COMPLIANCE_MATRIX.md` 4.4.2.2 / Table 5.6 row, `docs/testing/TESTING.md` avtp_rxmon and crf_rx rows | state the rule and its tests |

A discarded AAF PDU now takes one more walker cycle (PDEC, PSEQ, idle instead of PDEC, idle). That is still fewer than an accepted PDU takes. No register-map, port, parameter or interface change.

**New checks** (round 1; lines at `c7e87c8c`).

- `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/sim_main_nx.cpp:991-1075`, `[SQ]`, 22 checks. Stream 3 is freshly bound and locked. One 2-channel PDU against the current 8 channels arrives mid-stream. It carries a toggled mr, tu and a timestamp already past.
  - It has no accept verdict and emits no payload.
  - prev_seq becomes its sequence_num. LAST_TSD and wire_chans are unchanged.
  - Six in-order PDUs follow, over two observation intervals. UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT moves +1. SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH, MEDIA_RESET, TIMESTAMP_UNCERTAIN, LATE_TIMESTAMP, EARLY_TIMESTAMP, STREAM_INTERRUPTED and MEDIA_UNLOCKED do not move. FRAMES_RX moves +6.
  - Then a second off-format PDU (early) is followed by a gap of one lost PDU. SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH moves +1 and STREAM_INTERRUPTED does not move, so the gap is measured from the off-format PDU's sequence_num. Without the advance, two PDUs would count as lost.
- `tb/verilator/crf_rx/sim_main.cpp:1570-1685`, `[SQ]`, 23 checks. The same shape on the CRF input: an AAF PDU in a CRF PDU's slot, carrying a toggled mr, tu and a late (later early) reference timestamp.
  - It is not accepted, gives no timing point, leaves delta_o and keeps the lock.
  - The same counter holds as on AAF follow, over two intervals, and the same gap-of-one result.
  - `[SQ-d]`: an AAF PDU first in a fresh era seeds nothing. The first accepted PDU counts no SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH and no STREAM_INTERRUPTED, whatever sequence_num it carries.

**Planted mutants**, each required to fail its named check (`format_mutants.py`, crf_rx `mutants.py`):

| Mutant (where) | Named check | All checks it fails |
|---|---|---|
| no advance (`ctx.sv:1019` writes `ram_q_r` back) | `[SQ2c] SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH unchanged: the next PDU was in sequence` | `no mismatch across bad-format PDUs`, `[UF2g]`, `[SQ1c]`, `[SQ2c]`, `[SQ3c]` |
| whole state (`ctx.sv:1019` writes `monst_next_w`) | `[SQ2d] MEDIA_RESET unchanged` | `[UF2e]`, `[UF4g]`, `[SQ1e]`, `[SQ2d]`, `[SQ3f]` |
| accepted walk (`ctx.sv:1020` goes to `M_PWR_S`) | `[SQ1d] ...and it writes no timestamp word (LAST_TSD)` | `[SQ1d]` |
| CRF no advance (`crf_rx.sv:607` removed) | `[SQ-b2] SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH unchanged: the next PDU was in sequence` | `[5t-a5]`, `[ST-c3]`, `[FMT-c1]`, `[SQ-b2]`, `[SQ-c2]`, plus 170 per-PDU replica compares |
| CRF reject seeds (`have_seq_r <= 1` added) | `[SQ-d1] an AAF PDU first in an era seeds no SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH` | `seq skip: ONE interval tick`, `clean resume: seq_err holds at 1`, `[SQ-d1]`, `[SQ-d2]`, plus 1,972 per-PDU replica compares |

The head's harnesses built against dev `a032c6d6`'s two RTL files fail as the bench did. The AAF harness fails 5 checks, among them `[SQ2c]` (got 1, expected 0) and `[SQ3c]`. The CRF harness fails `[FMT-c1]`, `[SQ-b2]` and `[SQ-c2]` among 175 failures. The discontinuity harness fails `rejected marker never seeds the reference`.

### Round 3: the mr seed across a reject, and both planted copies built (R685-2, R686-2)

R685-2 F1 found that the testing guide said the mr seed was graded, while a reject that only set or cleared the seed survived every avtp_rxmon leg: every accepted `[SQ]` PDU carried mr = 0. R686-2 F1 found that `format_mutants.py`'s two-copy arms checked the reference's line but planted and built only the engine copy, while their messages said both. The RTL was correct in both cases: `{ram_q_r[31:8], seq}` keeps the seed and the reference. This round adds the two seed arms, makes the two-copy arms build both copies, and corrects the guide, with no logic change.

| Commit | File:line at `220b51f2` | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `a8ddb31a` | `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/sim_main_nx.cpp:1124-1148` `[SQ6]` | An off-format PDU, carrying mr = 1, first in a fresh era before the mr seed. It leaves the seed clear, and the era's first accepted PDU, carrying mr = 1, counts no MEDIA_RESET (it only seeds the reference) |
| `a8ddb31a` | `sim_main_nx.cpp:1150-1181` `[SQ7]` | An off-format PDU, carrying mr = 1, on a seeded stream whose mr reference is 0. It leaves the seed set, and the next accepted PDU, carrying mr = 1, counts MEDIA_RESET once; three more with mr held count nothing more |
| `a8ddb31a` | `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/format_mutants.py:22-37,99-122,157-221` | Each two-copy arm writes the planted engine and the planted reference and names both. It builds the N=4 stack from the planted engine (that stack compiles no reference), which must fail the arm's named `[SQ]` check, and the lockstep leg at N=1 and N=8 from both planted copies, whose result it prints as measured without grading it. Two new arms: a reject that sets the mr seed, and one that clears it |
| `a8ddb31a` | `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/Makefile:45-49` | comment: the driver also builds the lockstep leg from a mutated engine and reference |
| `de094b8a` | `docs/testing/TESTING.md:617` | It states the two seed arms, that a reject that sets the seed, clears it, or writes its own mr into the reference is graded through MEDIA_RESET, and what the two-copy arms build and grade |
| `db5d9d27` | `hdl/ieee1722/avtp/KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv:18-22` | Comments only (R685-2 R1): the banner's contract line rewrapped, same words |
| `220b51f2` | `format_mutants.py:104,214-220` | The lockstep result on a planted pair is printed as `N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 (checks/failures)`. Printed as the harness's own tally lines, it was read by the sweep's tally (`scripts/suite_tally.py`) as 464 checks of the tree (4 x 116), and a failing pair would have failed the suite |

| Two-copy arm (engine and reference planted) | Named check, N=4 stack | Every check it fails | Lockstep on the planted pair, as measured |
|---|---|---|---|
| lock set | `[SQ4f] MEDIA_LOCKED +1 at the first accepted PDU` | `[SQ4c]`, `[SQ4f]` | N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 |
| settle step | `[SQ5c] a gap at the window's last PDU counts no SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH` | `[SQ5c]`, `[SQ5d]`, `[SQ5g]` | N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 |
| mr seed set: the reject writes `{ram_q_r[31:24], 1'b1, ram_q_r[22:8], seq}` | `[SQ6e] ...and counts no MEDIA_RESET: it seeds the reference` (got 1) | `[SQ6c]`, `[SQ6e]`, `[SQ6i]` | N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 |
| mr seed clear: the same with `1'b0` | `[SQ7d] MEDIA_RESET +1 at the toggled PDU after the reject` (got 0) | `[SQ7c]`, `[SQ7d]`, `[SQ7e]` | N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 |

The lockstep passes on every pair: its compare cannot see a defect in both copies, which is why the `[SQ]` count checks carry the grade. The review's own probes were rerun at `220b51f2`. Its six-mutant seed and lock probe now catches all six (it caught four), and its lock and settle probe gives the round-2 result.

The RTL file is identical after comment stripping (`verilator -E -P`, and the review's own comment stripper; 804 lines each, the same SHA-256 as at `c2a080ae`), so no route was run. The round-1 route at `c7e87c8c` stands for the logic.

### Round 2: the lock and settle state across a reject (R685-1)

R685-1 F1 found that the AAF `[SQ]` cases ran on a locked, settled stream only. A reject that set media_locked, or stepped the settle count, survived every avtp_rxmon leg when it was planted in the engine and the lockstep reference together. The testing guide also claimed "writes only prev_seq", which the cases did not grade. The RTL was correct: `{ram_q_r[31:8], seq}` keeps bits 8 to 31. This round adds the two missing arms and corrects the guide, with no logic change.

| Commit | File:line at `c2a080ae` | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `50275e29` | `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/sim_main_nx.cpp:1066-1085` `[SQ4]` | An off-format PDU first in a fresh era, on an unlocked stream. The stream stays unlocked and counts no MEDIA_LOCKED at the reject. MEDIA_LOCKED counts once at the first accepted PDU after it, which locks the stream |
| `50275e29` | `sim_main_nx.cpp:1092-1119` `[SQ5]` | An off-format PDU inside the settle window, with one PDU of the window left. A gap at that PDU counts nothing, so the window was not shortened; the next gap counts SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH once, so it was not restarted |
| `50275e29` | `sim_main_nx.cpp:1007-1017,1123-1179` | Each new arm keeps the existing counter checks (UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT +1; MEDIA_RESET, TIMESTAMP_UNCERTAIN, LATE, EARLY, STREAM_INTERRUPTED, MEDIA_UNLOCKED +0; FRAMES_RX the accepted PDUs only). `[SQ]` is split into three phases with shared helpers so no function exceeds the 100-line ratchet. `[SQ0]` to `[SQ3]` are unchanged |
| `50275e29` | `tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/format_mutants.py:22-31,91-104,130-150,200-204` | Two arms, the review's `lock_set` and `settle_dec`. Each is the defect in the engine and in the same line of the lockstep reference. The arm fails if the reference no longer carries that line |
| `3f5cebd0` | `docs/testing/TESTING.md:617` | It states the three points of a stream `[SQ]` grades and the counters at each, that the mr reference and seed are graded through MEDIA_RESET, and that the 100 ms silence watchdog across a reject is not graded |
| `c2a080ae` | `hdl/ieee1722/avtp/KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv:15-23,96-100` | Comments only (R685-1 F2). #775 is listed among the N=1 deltas from the flat monitor, and the contract line no longer puts it inside the flat module's contract |

| Mutant (engine and reference together) | Named check | Every check it fails |
|---|---|---|
| lock set: the reject writes `{ram_q_r[31:13], 1'b1, ram_q_r[11:8], seq}` | `[SQ4f] MEDIA_LOCKED +1 at the first accepted PDU` (got 0) | `[SQ4c]`, `[SQ4f]` |
| settle step: the reject writes `settle == 0 ? 0 : settle - 1` | `[SQ5c] a gap at the window's last PDU counts no SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH` (got 1) | `[SQ5c]`, `[SQ5d]`, `[SQ5g]` |

The review's own probes were rerun at `c2a080ae`. With both defects planted in the engine and the reference, the N=4 stack now fails the named `[SQ]` checks, while the lockstep still passes, at N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0. The review's 13-mutant probe catches 12, where it caught 10. The survivor is a reject that refreshes the 100 ms silence watchdog. That behaviour predates #775 and is out of scope for this change.

The RTL file is identical after comment stripping (`verilator -E -P`, 804 lines each, the same SHA-256), so route-1x1 was not rerun. The round-1 route at `c7e87c8c` stands for the logic.

### Round 1

**Stimulus that reused a sequence number across a reject now consumes one.** Under the ruling a reused number is a real repeat: a SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH and, mod 256, a 255-PDU loss. Each site now drives an in-order stream with one PDU replaced. No check, count or expectation changes.

- avtp_rxmon `[G5]` (`sim_main_nx.cpp:339,346-348`), `[UF2]`, `[UF3]`, `[UF4c]` (`:931,938-939,949,960`).
- crf_rx: every reject site (`sim_main.cpp`, `m.bad_pdu(seq++)`). The replica's `bad_pdu(seq)` (`:191-197`) advances its cursor the same way.
- crf_rx `sim_discontinuity.cpp:138,198`.
- milan_dp `[CTRS-CRF]` event arm (`sim_nxn.cpp:7047,7065-7067`). Its planned counts are unchanged, because P2's two lost PDUs are now counted from the last reject.

## Authoritative references

- Milan v1.2 5.3.8.10 Table 5.6: SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH counts a Stream Data AVTPDU received with a non-sequential sequence_num. UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT counts one that "has been received with a format that did not match". 4.4.2.2: the Listener discards it.
- #775 and its ruling, #765 / PR #769 (the format compare this follows), FR-STR-03.
- `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md`, `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md`, `syn/ooc/pp_resource_baseline.json` (the 2026-10-23 record, #632/#764).

## How to get into the same state

```sh
git fetch origin
git switch --detach 220b51f2eb50c32f830e0b5a8ee1ce138b218bb6
git submodule update --init third_party/verilog-axis protocol-processor gptp-processor third_party/tsn-c-stack third_party/lwSRP
```

Verilator 5.050 first on `PATH` (the CI pin), sv2v v0.0.12, Yosys 0.66, Vivado 2026.1.

## How to validate

```sh
make -C tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon
make -C tb/verilator/crf_rx
(cd tests && behave --no-capture -f plain)
logs="$(mktemp -d)"
for k in 0 1 2 3; do bash scripts/run_all_suites.sh "$logs/$k" --wait --shard "$k/4"; done
syn/yosys/run.sh
python3 scripts/lint_rtl.py --check
python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py check <route-1x1 gateware dir> --endpoint route-1x1
```

Expected result / pass criteria:

- avtp_rxmon: rc 0. Flat 97/0, NX 218/0, lockstep N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0, `lockstep_mutants.py` 14/14, `format_mutants.py` 13/13. Each of its four two-copy arms prints its two planted files and the lockstep result on that pair (`N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 (checks/failures)`).
- crf_rx: rc 0. Unit 15,714/0, talker step 69/0, `mutants.py` 23/23.
- Sweep: every shard rc 0, 64/64 suites, 2,189,668 checks, 0 failures.
- behave: rc 0, 14 features, 406 scenarios, 0 failed.
- Yosys: rc 0. Lint: rc 0 at the ratchet (89 <= 89).
- route-1x1 (round 1, at `c7e87c8c`; rounds 2 and 3 change RTL comments only): the shipping AX7101 1x1 export per `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md` (`pp_baseline.py --single-thread-synthesis`), one Vivado run under the exclusive lock. Routed with all constraints met; the resource gate gives rc 0, RESULT: PASS (SLICE 15,833 against the record's 15,835; LUT 51,313 against 51,259; FF 53,218 against 53,208; WNS +0.141 ns; WHS +0.019 ns). The worst setup path is in the SoC bus (`axilite2wishbone` -> `spiflash_phy`), not the changed logic

## Known limitations / out of scope

- `[SQ]` does not grade the AAF input's 100 ms silence watchdog across a reject: a reject that refreshed it would pass every avtp_rxmon leg. That behaviour predates #775 and is unchanged here; it is left to the maintainer as a possible new issue (R685-1 F3).
- The flat test instrument `KL_avtp_rx_monitor` is unchanged. No shipping module instantiates it; it is the DUT of tsn_fuzz and of avtp_rxmon's flat leg. Its reject path still leaves `prev_seq_r` untouched (`KL_avtp_rx_monitor.sv:265-269`). Whether it should follow is left to the maintainer as a possible new issue.
- tsn_fuzz was not run: it builds only the flat instrument, which this change does not touch.
- The advance takes the off-format PDU's own sequence_num. A gap or repeat on the off-format PDU itself is not counted, because a rejected PDU counts only UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT (the ruling). The next PDU is measured from it.
- No hardware or bench run here. The bench check of #775 (in-order stream, one PDU replaced, SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH +0) is for the test machine.

- [ ] Post-merge containment will be checked before the Issue moves to Done

[A666] TAKEN
Branch: 775-offformat-seq-advance (from dev a032c6d6)
Authoritative references: Milan v1.2 Table 5.6 (SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH, UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT), 4.4.2.2; #765 / PR #769; the [A10] assignment on this issue.
Interpreted scope: a discarded off-format Stream Data AVTPDU advances the input's sequence state exactly as an accepted PDU would, and nothing else: on an AAF input (KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv, the !fmt_ok_w branch) prev_seq takes the PDU's sequence_num, with no lock, settle, mr, timestamp or presentation effect; on the CRF input (KL_crf_rx.sv, the rejected branch) exp_seq_r becomes sequence_num + 1, with have_seq_r (first-PDU seeding) unchanged. Self-checking tests plant one off-format PDU mid-stream on each input (another channel count on AAF, an AAF PDU on the CRF input) and assert UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT +1 and SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH, MEDIA_RESET, TIMESTAMP_UNCERTAIN, LATE_TIMESTAMP, EARLY_TIMESTAMP unchanged over the following observation intervals; a real gap after the off-format PDU still counts; a planted control that drops the advance fails.
Validation plan: avtp_rxmon and crf_rx suites with their mutant drivers; full sweep as 4 shards; Yosys; lint; docs gates under make 4.3; route-1x1 against the current record (STOP above +5 slices).
Blockers: none

[A666] REVIEW READY
Commit: c7e87c8c87494f3444000b46954648ba1a94dcb8 (branch 775-offformat-seq-advance, on dev a032c6d6; not pushed, the manager pushes and opens the PR)
Changed:
- AAF input, KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv:1009-1020: a discarded off-format PDU writes back MON_STATE with only prev_seq replaced by its sequence_num, through a new one-cycle state M_PSEQ_S (:292, :638-642, :1061). Lock, settle, wire_chans and the mr reference are unchanged. There is no accept verdict, no timestamp word and no counter walk, and only the UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT flag is raised. The lockstep reference takes the same edit.
- CRF input, KL_crf_rx.sv:603-607: the rejected branch sets exp_seq_r <= seq_i + 1. have_seq_r is untouched, so only an accepted PDU seeds the cursor.
- Tests: avtp_rxmon [SQ] (22 checks) and crf_rx [SQ] (23 checks). One off-format PDU mid-stream carries a toggled mr, tu and a late timestamp. It counts UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT +1. Over the two following observation intervals SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH, MEDIA_RESET, TIMESTAMP_UNCERTAIN, LATE_TIMESTAMP, EARLY_TIMESTAMP, STREAM_INTERRUPTED and MEDIA_UNLOCKED do not move. A gap of one after an off-format PDU counts SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH +1 and no STREAM_INTERRUPTED. On CRF, an AAF PDU first in an era seeds nothing.
- Stimulus that reused a sequence number across a reject now consumes one: avtp_rxmon [G5]/[UF], crf_rx, and the milan_dp [CTRS-CRF] event arm. No check or expectation changed.
- Docs: FR-STR-03, the compliance matrix row and the testing guide.
Validation (clean clones at the head):
- make -C tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon: rc 0. NX 169/0, lockstep 116/0 and 119/0, lockstep_mutants.py 14/14, format_mutants.py 9/9.
- make -C tb/verilator/crf_rx: rc 0. Unit 15714/0, discontinuity 2201/0, talker step 69/0, mutants.py 23/23.
- Planted controls, each failing its named check:
  - AAF no advance fails [SQ2c] SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH unchanged.
  - AAF whole MON_STATE fails [SQ2d] MEDIA_RESET unchanged.
  - AAF timestamp walk fails [SQ1d].
  - CRF no advance fails [SQ-b2].
  - CRF reject seeds fails [SQ-d1].
- The base RTL under the head's harnesses fails as the bench did: NX [SQ2c] got 1, crf_rx [SQ-b2]/[SQ-c2]/[FMT-c1].
- Full sweep as 4 parallel shards: rc 0, 64/64 suites, 2,189,615 checks, 0 failures.
- syn/yosys/run.sh: rc 0, 60/60 tops. lint_rtl.py --check: rc 0 (89 <= 89). 30 static gates: rc 0.
- Docs workflow gates under GNU Make 4.3: 42 run, rc 0, builder legs included. Not run: gate_42, which runs the candidate act_ci.py on the host, and the no-git step, whose two gates ran in place.
- route-1x1, one Vivado run under the exclusive lock after the sweep: routed, all constraints met, WNS +0.141 ns, WHS +0.019 ns. pp_resource_gate.py check --endpoint route-1x1: rc 0, PASS against the 2026-10-23 record: SLICE 15833 (-2), LUT +54, FF +10, RAMB and DSP unchanged. The STOP threshold (+5 slices) is not reached.
Acceptance criteria: met. Items 1-4 of the assignment and the issue's Required list are covered with the evidence above.
Open risks/questions:
- The flat test instrument KL_avtp_rx_monitor, which no shipping module instantiates, keeps its old reject path. Not assigned; a possible new issue.
- A gap or repeat on the discarded PDU itself counts nothing, per the ruling.
- No bench run here.

[A666] REVIEW READY
Commit: c2a080aef7cd9a4ee2cd1bb4f8214b529bfd8c83 (branch 775-offformat-seq-advance, round 2 of PR #777: three new commits on c7e87c8c, no rebase or amend, still on dev a032c6d6; not pushed, the manager pushes)
Changed (answering R685-1 per the round-2 assignment on PR #777):
- F1, tests (50275e29): tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/sim_main_nx.cpp adds two AAF [SQ] arms.
  - [SQ4], :1066-1085: an off-format PDU first in a fresh era, on an unlocked stream. The stream stays unlocked and MEDIA_LOCKED does not move at the reject; MEDIA_LOCKED +1 at the first accepted PDU after it.
  - [SQ5], :1092-1119: an off-format PDU inside the settle window with one PDU of it left. A gap at that PDU counts nothing (not shortened), and the next gap counts SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH +1 (not restarted).
  - Each arm keeps the existing counter checks. [SQ0]-[SQ3] are unchanged; [SQ] is split into three phases to stay under the 100-line function ratchet.
- F1, mutants (50275e29): format_mutants.py gains two arms, lock set and settle step (the review's lock_set and settle_dec), each the defect in the engine and in the same line of the lockstep reference.
- F1, docs (3f5cebd0): docs/testing/TESTING.md:617 states exactly what [SQ] grades at each of the three points, that the mr reference and seed are graded through MEDIA_RESET, and that the 100 ms silence watchdog across a reject is not graded.
- F2, comments only (c2a080ae): KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv:96-100 carries the review's exact delta text for #775, and :19-23 no longer places #775 inside the flat module's contract. The file is identical after comment stripping (verilator -E -P, 804 lines, same SHA-256), so no RTL line changed and route-1x1 was not rerun.
- F3: out of scope, per the assignment.
Validation (clean clones at c2a080ae, pinned Verilator 5.050):
- make -C tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon: rc 0. Flat 97/0, NX 194/0, lockstep N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0, lockstep_mutants.py 14/14, format_mutants.py 11/11.
- Planted controls, engine and reference together:
  - lock set fails [SQ4f] MEDIA_LOCKED +1 at the first accepted PDU (got 0), and [SQ4c].
  - settle step fails [SQ5c] a gap at the window's last PDU counts no SEQ_NUM_MISMATCH (got 1), and [SQ5d] and [SQ5g].
- The review's probe_lock_settle.py from the archived packet: with both copies planted, NX now fails those named [SQ] checks, while the lockstep still passes (116/0, 119/0). The review's probe_mutants.py: 12 of 13 caught (10 at c7e87c8c). The survivor is F3.
- Full sweep as 4 parallel shard units: rc 0, 64/64 suites, 2,189,642 checks, 0 failures (+27 over round 1: NX +25, format_mutants +2).
- lint_rtl.py --check: rc 0 (89 <= 89). The 30 static gates: rc 0.
- Docs workflow gates under GNU Make 4.3: 42 run, rc 0, builder legs included. Not run, as in round 1: gate_42 and the no-git step.
Acceptance criteria: met. The issue's acceptance items are unchanged since round 1, where the review found all of them met; R685-1 F1 and F2 are now closed by the evidence above.
Open risks/questions:
- F3, a reject that refreshes the 100 ms silence watchdog, is ungraded and predates #775. It is left to the manager as a possible new issue.
- The flat test instrument KL_avtp_rx_monitor keeps its old reject path, as in round 1.
- No bench run here.

[A666] REVIEW READY
Commit: 220b51f2eb50c32f830e0b5a8ee1ce138b218bb6 (branch 775-offformat-seq-advance, round 3 of PR #777: four new commits on c2a080ae, no rebase or amend, still on dev a032c6d6; not pushed, the manager pushes)
Changed (answering R685-2 and R686-2 per the round-3 assignment on PR #777; tests, docs and one comment rewrap, no RTL line):
- R686-2-F1 and R685-2-S1 (a8ddb31a): format_mutants.py's two-copy arms now write both planted copies and build both. The N=4 stack is built from the planted engine (it compiles no reference) and must fail the arm's named [SQ] check. The lockstep leg at N=1 and N=8 is built from the planted engine and the planted reference, and its result is printed as measured, not graded. Each arm prints its two planted file names and the lockstep result on the pair.
- R685-2-F1 (a8ddb31a), the review's option (b). tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon/sim_main_nx.cpp adds two arms:
  - [SQ6], :1124-1148: a reject on a freshly bound stream, then the era's first accepted PDU with mr = 1, which counts no MEDIA_RESET.
  - [SQ7], :1150-1181: a reject on a seeded stream (mr reference 0), then an accepted PDU with mr = 1, which counts MEDIA_RESET once.
  - format_mutants.py also gains two two-copy arms, mr seed set and mr seed clear (the review's mr_seed_set and mr_seed_clear, byte for byte).
- Docs (de094b8a): docs/testing/TESTING.md:617 states the two seed arms. It says a reject that sets the seed, clears it, or writes its own mr into the reference is graded through MEDIA_RESET, and it says what the two-copy arms build and grade.
- R685-2-R1, comments only (db5d9d27): the banner rewrap at KL_avtp_rx_monitor_ctx.sv:18-22, same words. The file at c2a080ae and 220b51f2 is identical after comment stripping by verilator -E -P (804 lines, 026a45f4...) and by the review's strip_sv_comments.py (804 lines, 7c744642...). No route was run.
- Tally fix (220b51f2): the lockstep result on a planted pair is printed as "N=1 116/0, N=8 119/0 (checks/failures)". At db5d9d27 it was printed as the harness's own tally lines, and the sweep's tally (scripts/suite_tally.py) read the first tally on each of those 4 lines, so it counted 464 checks of mutant pairs as checks of the tree. A failing pair would also have failed the suite. The db5d9d27 runs are kept under receipts/round3/superseded-db5d9d27; every gate was rerun at 220b51f2.
Validation (clean clones at 220b51f2, pinned Verilator 5.050):
- make -C tb/verilator/avtp_rxmon: rc 0. Flat 97/0, NX 218/0, lockstep N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0, lockstep_mutants.py 14/14, format_mutants.py 13/13. The sweep's tally reads its log as 577 checks (97+218+116+119+14+13).
- Two-copy arms. Each fails its named check in the N=4 stack; the lockstep on each planted pair, as measured, gives rc 0 at N=1 116/0 and N=8 119/0:
  - lock set fails [SQ4f], and also [SQ4c].
  - settle step fails [SQ5c], and also [SQ5d] and [SQ5g].
  - mr seed set fails [SQ6e] ...and counts no MEDIA_RESET: it seeds the reference (got 1), and also [SQ6c] and [SQ6i].
  - mr seed clear fails [SQ7d] MEDIA_RESET +1 at the toggled PDU after the reject (got 0), and also [SQ7c] and [SQ7e].
- The review's probe_sq_claims.py from the archived packet catches 6 of 6 (4 of 6 at c2a080ae). Its probe_lock_settle.py gives the round-2 result.
- cd tests && behave --no-capture -f plain: rc 0, 14 features, 406 scenarios, 1977 steps, 0 failed.
- Full sweep as 4 parallel shard units: rc 0, 64/64 suites, 2,189,668 checks, 0 failures (+26 over round 2: NX +24, format_mutants +2).
- lint_rtl.py --check: rc 0 (89 <= 89). The 30 static gates: rc 0.
- Docs workflow gates under GNU Make 4.3: 42 run, rc 0, builder legs included. Not run, as in rounds 1 and 2: gate_42 and the no-git step.
- The new arms pass on the shipping RTL, so no arm shows the RTL wrong and no STOP.
Acceptance criteria: met. The issue's acceptance items are unchanged since round 1. R685-2 F1 and R1 and R686-2 F1 are answered by the evidence above.
Open risks/questions:
- R685-1-F3, a reject that refreshes the 100 ms silence watchdog, is still ungraded and disclosed. It is left to the manager.
- The flat test instrument KL_avtp_rx_monitor keeps its old reject path, as in round 1.
- No bench run here.
